text:
jana (PM): quick heads-up  planning session notes: three customer asks landed this week that should influence our console observability sprint: feature-level cost rollups, per-route latency density views, and grouping errors by prompt template/signature. want to align scope & acceptance so we can put clear cards on the board.

omar (Eng): TL;DR: cost rollups = pipeline + mapping table; latency density = histogram buckets + compact UI; error grouping = metadata capture + scrubber. main unknown is whether we can capture template_id without exploding trace storage.

lee (SRE): operational constraints: adding template_id as indexed tag will increase cardinality. options: 1) store template_id only in metrics (not traces) and add a trace pointer, or 2) use hashed template_id with TTL/eviction. both need changes to tracer exporter.

nina (CS): Customer X specifically needs cost allocated to product lines monthly for forecasting. Customer Y wants a dashboard that surfaces the top 10 slow routes and can drill into example traces. Customer Z asked for error counts by prompt family. All say speed-to-insight matters more than perfect fidelity.

vik (Data): For exports: we'll surface a managed daily table: date, customer_id, route_id, cost_usd, tokens_in, tokens_out, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_count, template_hash. we can allow BigQuery exports for Dedicated only initially.

omar (Eng): Suggested MVP split (goal: ship within 4 weeks): A) ship cost rollups + CSV export (2w), B) basic latency heatmap widget with p50/p90/p99 toggles (1w), C) error grouping UI that links to sample trace (1w). Do not enable template indexing by default; include opt-in flag.

jana (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal: - cost rollup table available for last 30/90 days with CSV export - latency density plot per-route with bucket selector and export - error grouping lists top 20 templates with sample trace link and count - scrubber applied to template text before display/export.

lee (SRE): security note: scrubber must run before logs/traces leave customer boundary. for Hosted we need a customer consent toggle and legal sign-off if templates are exported. sec-bot: attaching compliance checklist link: https://sec.redwood/compliance/telemetry-guidelines

nina (CS): prioritize cost rollups + CSV early access to Customer X. they'll validate mapping accuracy and help with label definitions.

omar (Eng): Implementation risks: aggregation lag vs realtime expectations, and UI perf when loading many routes. mitigation: paginate route list, precompute daily aggregates, provide live sample only for top N.

vik (Data): data model draft: we'll keep canonical route metadata in services.routes table and join on route_id. template_hash is sha256(template_text) stored with last_seen_ts. We can TTL hash entries older than 90 days to limit growth.

jana (PM): prioritization: if we must cut scope, drop full real-time heatmap and keep daily-bucketed heatmaps. flag error grouping as alpha behind feature flag.

lee (SRE): runbook note: if trace ingestion spikes after enabling template hashing, flip feature flag and revert exporter. add alert if unique_template_hashes > 100k in 24h.

omar (Eng): follow-ups: i'll open RFC for data model + exporter changes and include a small spec for scrubber (redaction rules). will attach minimal wireframes for the table + heatmap.

jana (PM): action list: - omar: RFC + wires by Mon (1723536000) - lee: tracer exporter change + runbook by Thu - vik: export schema & sample BI query by Wed - nina: confirm pilot customers and legal gating. we'll review RFC Wed 3pm.

sec-bot: security scan reminder: new telemetry fields require PR checklist entry #TR-12.

nina (CS): i'll coordinate pilots. Customer X in for CSV alpha, Customer Y for heatmap alpha.

jana (PM): thanks team. i'll create roadmap cards and mark this item as "customer-priority". will update stakeholders after RFC review.

omar (Eng): prototype query for latency buckets: ```SELECT route_id, width_bucket(latency_ms, 0, 2000, 40) AS bucket, count(*) FROM requests WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2;```

lee (SRE): +1. also: we should include a recommendation in the PR about retention windows and aggregation cadence.

jana (PM): perfect. logging this thread to the board. ping me if blockers.
